Stage 5: Shaftesbury went ahead for the first time while Roger Alsop overtook Harrow but lost out to Thames Hare & Hounds' Wayne Oxborough. Our Captain clocked a very respectable 24:51 to place 31st overall on the day and move the team half a minute closer to the leaders.
